description_en: Removes tags from ApsaraDB for ClickHouse clusters

kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id cc-bp1t9lbb7a4z70000 --resource-type DBCLUSTER --all false --tag-key testkey1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

Specifies whether to remove all tags from the cluster. Valid values:

- **true**

- **false** (default)

> This parameter is valid only when the **TagKey.N** parameter is empty.
